title: Character expectation and polynomial roots
statement: Let $n,\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell\ne0$, and let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$ be nonzero. Choose $r,s$ independently and uniformly from the binary extension field $\mathbb F_{2^\ell}$. The expectation of the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$, evaluated at the shifted small bias generator determined by $r,s$, equals the number of roots in $\mathbb F_{2^\ell}$ of $p_\gamma(X)=\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\gamma_iX^i$, divided by $2^\ell$.
